Where · When · Which way?
Prepositions of place

Test yourself

Three useful groups

PlaceWhere is something? In, on, under, next to …
TimeWhen does it happen? At, on, in, since …
MovementWhere is it going? To, into, across, through …

Tip: Read each example aloud and make a new sentence of your own.
